# Burning Springs: Grunt Hunt Rewards

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0949a677c8de495eb8e24a3f291a9545~mv2.jpg)

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

__Grunt Hunt Rewards__

For every successful event, you will receive

**XP**

1000 XP

**Legendary Modules**

You receive up to 3 Legendary Modules:

- 1 module – 100%
- 1 additional module – 60% chance
- 1 additional module – 40% chance

**Event Legendary (reward screen)**

You always receive 1 legendary item. Item types include weapon, armor, or power armor.

Star rating matches the Outlaw:

- 1* Outlaw → 1* legendary
- 2* Outlaw → 2* legendary
- 3* Outlaw → 3* legendary

The event pulls your legendary reward from one of two lists. One list (Legendary) contains only the old legendary mods. The other list (Bounty Legendary) contains the old mods plus the new ones. Because the game can choose either list for your drop, you aren’t guaranteed to roll on the list that includes the new mods. That lowers the overall chance of getting a piece of gear with one of the new legendary mods.

**Boss Legendary (Outlaw)**

The Outlaw will drop one legendary item that you can loot from its corpse. The item can be a weapon, armor, or power armor piece.

Star rating matches the Outlaw:

- 1* Outlaw → 1* legendary
- 2* Outlaw → 2* legendary
- 3* Outlaw → 3* legendary

The Outlaw’s corpse only pulls from one list, the Bounty Legendary list, which contains both the old and new legendary mods. Because it always uses this single mixed list, the chance of getting a piece of gear with one of the new mods is higher.

**Wanted Poster**

You have a chance to receive 1 Wanted Poster (for free Head Hunts) every 3 to 6 successful Grunt Hunts.

A poster will not drop if you already have one in your inventory. If you plan to stockpile them to run back-to-back later, stash each poster as soon as it drops so new ones can continue dropping for you.

Wanted Posters are:

- Non tradable
- Cannot be dropped
- Cannot be displayed
- Cannot be sold or scrapped

**1* Bounty Legendary List**

Scrap for Mod Boxes

- 1* item: 1% chance for a Mod Box

Scrap to learn a mod plan

- Scrapping any legendary item has a flat 1.5% chance to unlock a new mod plan, no matter how many stars the item has.

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three ;)
